scene: The crystal flashes, projecting shimmering transit lines out across the open city sky.
picture: Side-view from the opened lighthouse balcony. On the left sits an idling green dragon-headed maglev. In the centre you stand in your red jacket and skates on the stone ledge. Up high hangs an open spherical cable pod. On the far right is a pink bullet train waiting at an attached sky platform.
shown: a sleek dragon-headed maglev train idling along a neon track on the left
a spherical wicker cable pod hanging open from a cable up high
a pink streamlined bullet train waiting at an attached platform on the far right
